description: This file defines the 'PaymentMethod' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Account' namespace. It contains methods related to managing customer payment methods, including listing, adding, deleting, and handling payment methods within the customer's account in an OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class managing customer's payment methods in their account, including listing, adding, and deleting stored payment methods.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the default page for payment methods, loading language, checking customer login, setting breadcrumbs, and rendering the payment method view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of available payment methods; handles customer authentication and renders the payment method list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Internal method that retrieves and compiles the list of payment methods available to the logged-in customer.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a stored payment method for the customer, handling permission checks, and returns a JSON response.
